description: This file is a shell script for testing repository cloning and commit history preservation using Perforce and Git integration (git-p4). It sets up repositories, performs clone operations under various configurations, and verifies the commit logs.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the Perforce server daemon for testing.

methods.name: client_view
methods.description: Sets the client view mapping for the Perforce workspace.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up the git repository after testing.
